svg.aria-label: In three steps. 1: in the panel, you choose Connect Hermes and paste a block into Hermes's command channel. 2: it installs the connector and replies with a verification code, which you type into the panel. 3: you grant access and it starts reading and acting on the numbers you allowed.
svg.title: In three steps. 1: in the panel, you choose Connect Hermes and paste a block into Hermes's command channel. 2: it installs the connector and replies with a verification code, which you type into the panel. 3: you grant access and it starts reading and acting on the numbers you allowed.
